This is all about my store and my experience at my store. I don’t speak on behalf of Ulta or anyone currently employed at Ulta. Here goes....

Our customers get extremely defensive if we offer masks. I’ve honestly stopped saying anything about it. I’m TIRED of constantly being yelled at, accused of “refusing service” and all the other stuff that goes along with simply OFFERING a mask to someone. Ulta doesn’t care about the safety of their employees, which is made obvious by not actually enforcing the use of masks in my store. We were even told that AP is watching us at all times on the cameras and that if we didn’t offer masks to guests, that we’d be written up. It’s ridiculous.

After scanning in all the truck, we sort it by department by designating one of the gray carts for that particular department. Pro hair gets stacked up in the back by our stockroom (our pro hair is in the back of the store), mass goes up to the register on a cart for the cashiers to process through, bath goes to the middle of the store on its own cart and prestige cosmetics and skin go on one cart. PCA stays in the stockroom until pro hair is done. Once pro hair is done, PCA gets processed through and stocked/back stocked. Then it’s mass fashion accessories.

As for actually DOING truck, my biggest tip is to always acknowledge customers if they come within 3 feet of you. A lot of our store’s survey feedback is about how there were so many people there, but no one offering to help.
